_comment: Role -> account, by the role the server actually issues (JWT 'role' claim, verified 30-Oct-2026). Passwords come from OPSDESK_PASSWORD (or OPSDESK_<ROLE>_PASSWORD) in .env. Leave email empty for roles without a credential - their scenarios are skipped. NOTE: the credential list supplied to QA labelled sakthibalaji.m as 'Customer' and saraswathi.karunanidhi as 'Agent'; their real roles are employee and team_lead.
